about: Every line Bean speaks, and when. A copy for reading: the app speaks from the source files named in "source", not from this file.

play.when: Kid held still through a Red light (Red Light, Green Light), one at random
says: I did not see a thing!

play.when: Kid moved during a Red light: the game ends
play.says: I saw you move! Game over.

play.when: Kid got closer than the win distance during Red
12 Red lights passed with no catch and no win: nobody is playing, so the game ends
play.says: Is anybody there? I'll stop for now. Bye!

tuningPage.when: Result of each practice Red light
